hero.subtitle: Our Journey
hero.title: Three Generations of Farming. One Operating System.
hero.quote: A single seed holds the promise of generations. Our story begins in Odienné — where ancestral wisdom meets custom-built technology.

intro.title: From Family Farm to Tech-Enabled Agribusiness
intro.description: AfriNuts Export combines three generations of cashew farming heritage with a custom-built operating system — Farm OS — and Islamic ethical principles. We are building a vertically integrated operation where every tree, every expense, and every harvest is tracked digitally. From seed to export, we don't just grow cashews. We prove how they were grown.

timeline.title: Our Path to Impact
timeline.subtitle: From humble beginnings to a tech-enabled vision for West Africa's agricultural future

heritage.title: Rooted in Heritage
content: Our story begins in Odienné, a land of heritage, cultivation, and resilience. AfriNuts was not built solely on cashews, but on a commitment: to honor tradition, embrace innovation, and deliver meaningful transformation.
For decades, our family has worked hand in hand with local farmers, cultivating trust and excellence, and mastering the craft of growing world-class cashews.

tradition.title: Tradition Meets Technology
tradition.alt: Cashew farming tradition meets Farm OS
content: Cashews are more than a crop; they are our foundation. They represent a bond between the land and its people.

But tradition alone does not secure the future. So we did something unusual for a West African farm: we built our own software. Farm OS — an offline-first Android application that tracks every block, every tree, and every harvest. Not because it was easy. Because transparency demanded it.

innovation.title: Sustainable Innovation, Powered by Data
innovation.alt: Sustainable farming innovation with Farm OS
content: At AfriNuts Export, sustainability is not a slogan; it's measured. Our Farm OS tracks organic inputs, water usage, and soil health metrics per block — so we can prove our environmental claims, not just state them.

Every cashew we harvest is logged with GPS coordinates, harvest date, and quality data. By 2031, our state-of-the-art processing facility will bring value-added transformation to our region — with every batch traceable from tree to container.

community.title: Community Commitment
content: AfriNuts Export goes beyond business. It is about empowerment. Our mission is tied to the success of the people we serve.

Guided by our Islamic values, we reinvest 10% of profits into the local Muslim community — building wells, a masajid, and a madrassa rooted in Qur'an and Sunnah. This is not branding — it's an obligation.

future.title: A Tech-Enabled Future
content: We are planting seeds of change. With every job created, every harvest improved, and every line of code written for Farm OS, we are cultivating a stronger, more resilient future for our communities.

Africa, especially West Africa, is the promised land for those seeking genuine, long-term business opportunities. AfriNuts Export is that trusted door — rooted in the land, respected by the people, powered by technology, and aligned with global standards.

cta.title: Join Our Story
cta.subtitle: When you choose AfriNuts Export, you choose a purpose. You choose legacy. You choose a tech-enabled agribusiness that proves what it promises.
